recommended_offer.offer: Pilot engagement to identify, requalify, and route previously overlooked or abandoned real estate/mortgage leads for incremental monetization.
recommended_offer.deliverable: Tracked batch of 100–250 overlooked/non-closed leads requalified under updated criteria with outcome report (acceptance, routing, conversion).
recommended_offer.problem_solved: Sunk-value leads ignored by real estate/mortgage organizations are lost revenue; pilot seeks to unlock this value.
recommended_offer.why_this_offer: Focuses on the highest-probability overlooked value (abandoned leads), fast/measurable feedback, minimal commitment, and capacity test prior to automation.
recommended_offer.implementation_scope: Small pilot, manual/semi-automated, no new integration upfront, use existing reporting. Downstream buyers must be ready.
recommended_offer.what_not_to_build_yet: No custom CRM/integrations, no automated rerouting/event pipelines, no new app dev before pilot validation.
recommended_offer.expected_customer_value: Incremental revenue with low cost/risk. If pilot works, justifies further build and scale.
recommended_offer.measurable_success_metric: % of leads requalified, routed, accepted, converted; incremental revenue/referral from reclaimed leads.

current_operations.operational_gaps: Entire operational picture is unknown—synthetic customer. Industry standard is CRM-based, automated follow-up, and AI/automation for reactivating aged leads; validated only generally, not for this specific case.

ideal_lead_definition.lead_definition: A contact or opportunity relevant to a real estate/mortgage transaction with sufficient contact/property info and timely qualifying event/activity (e.g., probate, pre-foreclosure).
ideal_lead_definition.priority_factors: Event triggers (probate, foreclosure, urgency), high property value, buyer alignment, conversion history.
ideal_lead_definition.capacity_constraints: Unknown—should match buyer/agent ability to act without overload.
ideal_lead_definition.qualification_criteria: Sufficient data for routing/contact, positive event/intent, fits current buyer/appetite, within focus geography.
ideal_lead_definition.disqualification_criteria: Incomplete info, outside market/scope, explicit prior rejection, long-stale or blocked for legal/compliance.
ideal_lead_definition.price_or_value_thresholds: Unknown—expect higher value for imminent/event-driven and proven conversion leads.
ideal_lead_definition.recommended_qualification_formula: Lead contains requisite info, recent/event trigger, aligns with current buyer and measurable outcome, or otherwise WATCH (future potential).

recommended_next_action: Present findings, recommended pilot compensation (hybrid or per-qualified-lead for maximum outcome alignment), and discovery questions to the customer for validation before advancing beyond pilot.
